d: Long, straight chocolate brown hair with long bangs swept to the side and a small clip on the left. Narrow, sharp-looking hazel eyes set on a youthful face with a mature expression. A slender build, wearing a white long-sleeved top with a high collar, a dark grey breastplate, and a short pleated red skirt. The outfit is accessorized with a red sash tied at the waist and large, mechanical dark grey ship-rigging components attached to the back.
